contentPattern.structure: name text + subject select + (email + mobile two-column) + message textarea + send button

suitableFor: static contact / enquiry forms migrated from DA projects without the AEM Forms plugin
pet-travel, support and general contact forms with name/subject/email/phone/message fields
notSuitableFor: functional forms requiring real submission (use the AEM Forms plugin / adaptive form block)

notes: Static, display-only representation. The AEM Forms plugin is NOT enabled for this DA migration, so this block renders the form fields visually without submitting - consistent with the hardcoded booking-widget and static newsletter blocks. Content model: block-name row, then one row per field ([type | name | label | placeholder-or-options]) and a final [submit | label] row.
